newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Cho Kwang says buying back own shares.
newsitem.headline: Cho Kwang says buying back own shares.

text.p: Cho Kwang Leather said on Wednesday it would buy back 132,272 of its own common shares between December 1 and February 28.

The buyback, representing 4.76 percent of its outstanding shares, will be handled through Hanil Securities and Bookook Securities, a company statement said. It currently does not hold any of its own shares.
Cho Kwang said it was buying the shares to help "stabilise its management control". It did not elaborate.
The shares would be purchased at the previous day's closing prices, it said.
Cho Kwang closed at 17,000 won, up 500 on Wednesday.
